sources.entry: Monitoring Weekly - What's new in monitoring? Curated monitoring articles to your inbox each week.

summary.name: Monitoring Weekly
summary.one_liner: A weekly email newsletter that curates about 8-12 high-quality articles, news items, and new tools about monitoring.
use_cases: Keeping up with monitoring news without reading dozens of links
Finding new monitoring and observability tools
Discovering high-quality DevOps and SRE articles
Weekly reading for engineers on deployment and build topics
summary.what_it_does: The page promotes Monitoring Weekly, an email newsletter in which the curator reviews the week's tech content and compiles the best articles, news, and new tools. Each issue is kept short, with about 8-12 links. The curator says the selection excludes fluff and blogspam. The page text does not describe a web archive, search feature, or any other format beyond the emailed newsletter.
notable: Curated weekly issues with about 8-12 links
Covers monitoring articles, news, and new tools
Short format aimed at saving reading time
caveats: The page does not state pricing or whether the newsletter is free
Delivered by email only, as far as the page text shows
